# Seth Michael James

> Director of Nappanee Public Library in Indiana since 2022. Experience in budgets, complex projects, and stakeholder management. Libraries since 2008.

Contact: sethmjames@pm.me
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sethmjames/
Location: Indiana, United States.
Interests: How people make decisions, how organizations navigate change, and how technology can help.

## Scope

- Annual budget over $2.3 million.
- Leads a staff of more than 20, including 7 direct reports.
- Works closely with a Board of Trustees, two counties' commissioners and councils, multiple township boards, and a school board.
- Presents to the Board of Trustees 13+ times a year and has never lost a vote before the Board, the county councils and commissioners, or the school board.
- Manages relationships with local leaders, business owners, and other community stakeholders.

## Delivered

- Integrated library system selection and migration (went live 2024). Led a committee that scored three vendors on cost, support, fit with local processes, and migration experience. Negotiated the contract, won Board of Trustees approval, and managed the vendor through implementation, with training for all staff.
- $4.6M interior renovation, initiated by him and approved by the city council, the county council, and the Board of Trustees. Reached substantial completion in November 2026, under budget and with three closure days.
- Large-scale digitization projects at Vigo County Public Library, where he was Special Collections Manager from 2018 to 2022. These included the LSTA-funded John A. Curry Architectural Works project of more than 4,000 images, now published on Indiana Memory.
- Local history museum, its exhibits, and its large-scale digitization projects.
- New strategic plan for Nappanee Public Library, informed by a community survey (online and on paper) and formally implemented in early 2026.

## Education

- Master of Library Science (rare books and manuscripts) and Master of History, Indiana University, 2018.
- BA in English, Hillsdale College, 2012.
